methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 high-search single-function slow cookers (Crock-Pot, Hamilton Beach, KitchenAid, Elite Gourmet, Ninja, All-Clad, BLACK+DECKER, Cuisinart) spanning manual to programmable, 2 qt to 8.5 qt; the Ninja MC1001 is a multicooker whose slow-cook mode is a primary marketed function. Each product was re-verified June 2026 against official brand pages (crock-pot.com, hamiltonbeach.com, all-clad.com, sharkninja.com, blackanddecker.com, cuisinart.com), major retailers (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy, WebstaurantStore) and aggregator snapshots (kitchencritics.com). priceUsd reflects the lowest CONFIRMED published US retail price for the exact model in June 2026, or null when the model is discontinued/sold out OR when no stable published USD price could be independently corroborated (several major-retailer pages are bot-protected; a null is used rather than guessing). Booleans true if explicitly confirmed by manufacturer/retailer copy, false if explicitly absent, null if not stated. accessedAt 2026-06-20.
